## Fast and powerful remote support tool delivered as a SaaS solution

Dameware Remote Everywhere is a fast, simple, and lightweight cloud-based remote support solution, accessible from almost anywhere with an internet connection.

### Fast and safe remote control

When an end user has an issue, DRE helps you solve it fast. Avoid long connection or software response times.

View Less

### Establish secure active sessions in no time.

Don’t waste time. SolarWinds® Dameware Remote Everywhere (DRE) typically connects to workstations in less than eight seconds to help you save time. DRE is designed to help keep user data safe via advanced encryption protocols and support for two-factor authentication, as well as multilevel permissions.

[Learn More](https://www.solarwinds.com/dameware/use-cases/secure-rdp)

### Unattended support & Wake-on-LAN

Don’t bother an end user unnecessarily; resolve their issues from behind the scenes.

### Go beyond live support sessions with unattended remote support and Wake-on-LAN

Dameware Remote Everywhere is built to let technicians connect to remote devices no matter where you are or what device you’re connecting to. Complete attended or unattended support sessions or use Wake-on-LAN to remotely access and troubleshoot sleeping and powered-off devices.

![Image 9: dre-access-sleeping-computers.png](https://p1.aprimocdn.net/solarwinds/c10b5406-6419-4378-a56b-b3990133cee8/dre-access-sleeping-computers.png_Original%20file.png?auto=webp&format=webply&width=1024&height=640&disable=upscale&quality=50)

Get almost all the information you need to resolve an issue at the beginning of a support session

### Solve problems without disturbing the end user and easily share important information

DRE gives you system info, BIOS, and device details, in addition to Windows event logs and updates. Take screenshots, add notes and save details for each session to share important troubleshooting information with teammates. You can also save recorded sessions in the cloud.
